第17章 憋屈的红云老祖（第1页）
自己好不容易真灵觉醒，竟然落得个凄惨下场。
怎一个惨字了得，红云老祖心里憋屈无比，想杀人。
陈长生神念和其沟通，“红云老祖，你该知道虎落平阳被犬欺，这一切都是时也命也，你阴谋算计我，现在被我封印，天道轮回，一切都有定数。”
“狗屁的天道轮回！小子，我劝你赶紧放我出去，否则的话老祖把你的飞剑给炸了！”红云老祖疯狂咆哮，恨不得冲出来和陈长生同归于尽。
“那你就炸吧，我大不了损失一把飞剑，你恐怕会彻底魂飞魄散，我倒要看看你有没有那个魄力。”
陈长生冷笑，根本不为所动，自己要是把这老魔放出来，他第一个就不会放过自己。
红云老祖眼珠子乱转，不知道在想些什么，陈长生说的不错，他现在只是元灵，又被那小鼎照了一下伤了本源。
就算是能毁了飞剑出来恐怕也是魂飞魄散的下场。
他苟了数万年，就想要恢复修为，没想到栽在了一名小炼气期手里。
“红云老祖，我答应你，只要你以后好好配合我，辅助我修炼，等我成就仙道就放你自由，为你凝练肉身，我看出来了，你现在缺少一个强大的肉身。”
陈长生开始画大饼，这样一个千年老魔，如果好好配合自己，那飞剑的威力肯定比一般的大。
但如果不好好配合，关键时刻使绊子就麻烦了，况且这老魔阅历丰富，肯定能够从他那掏出很多修炼方面的知识。
这简直就是一个巨大的宝藏，他的阅历比作为剑灵的价值大多了。
陈长生一瞬间就转过千般念头，如果有红云老祖指点，那自己肯定少走许多弯路。
这种老魔头身上有多少功法，神通，不用想就知道。
“哼，蝼蚁一般的东西，等你修炼到仙道，还不知道猴年马月，没准半道被人打杀了，就你，还想让我辅助你，你就死了这条心吧，现在你乖乖把我放出去，我就当事情没有发生，否则的话鱼死网破！”
红云老祖很是不屑，陈长生才炼气期修为，他根本就看不上，这样的修为，当年他吹口气都能吹死很多。

“这个你就别管了，反正你要想脱身，必须助我，否则的话你就准备一辈子在里面待着吧！”
陈长生说完一掐法诀，飞剑落了下来，他跳上飞剑朝修真集市飞了过去。
修真集市距离望仙宗不远，算得上是依附于望仙宗存在的一个集市，是所有修真者交易的地方。
现在陈长生也算是有了自保之力，到集市中买点东西。
现在他身上有不少丹药，可以到集市上去换点灵石或者买点修炼资源。
红云老祖没有说话，显然也在沉思。
在距离修真集市还有一段距离的时候，陈长生收了飞剑，大摇大摆进了进去。
现在的陈长生有飞剑，还有灵器，炼气九层，这样的修为也算是有了些自保之力。

Chapter 17 The frustrated Ancestor Hongyun (Page 1)
After finally awakening his true spirit, he ended up with a miserable end.
How could such a word be so tragic? Ancestor Hongyun felt extremely aggrieved and wanted to kill someone.
Chen Changsheng communicated with him with his spiritual thoughts, "Ancestor Hongyun, you should know that the tiger fell flat and was bullied by the dog. All this is fate. You conspired against me, and now you are sealed by me. The reincarnation of heaven, everything is destined."
"Bullshit reincarnation! Boy, I advise you to let me out quickly, otherwise the ancestor will blow up your flying sword!" Ancestor Hongyun roared crazily, wanting to rush out and die with Chen Changsheng.
"Then just blow it up. The worst I can do is lose a flying sword, and I'm afraid your soul will be completely shattered. I want to see if you have the courage."
Chen Changsheng sneered, unmoved at all. If he released this old devil, he would not let him go first.
Ancestor Hongyun's eyes were rolling around, and he didn't know what he was thinking. Chen Changsheng was right. He was just a Yuanling now, and he was hit by the small cauldron and injured his origin.
Even if he could destroy the flying sword and come out, he would probably end up in a state of disarray.
He had been struggling for tens of thousands of years and wanted to recover his cultivation, but he unexpectedly fell into the hands of a young Qi refining stager.
"Ancestor Hongyun, I promise you that as long as you cooperate with me well in the future and assist me in my cultivation, I will set you free when I achieve the immortal path and condense a physical body for you. I can see that you lack a strong physical body now."
Chen Changsheng began to draw a pie. If such a thousand-year-old devil cooperates with him well, the power of the flying sword will definitely be greater than ordinary ones.
But if you don't cooperate well, it will be troublesome to trip up the enemy at the critical moment. Besides, this old devil has rich experience, and he will definitely be able to extract a lot of knowledge about cultivation from him.
This is simply a huge treasure. His experience is much more valuable than being a sword spirit.
Chen Changsheng changed his thoughts in an instant. If Ancestor Hongyun had given him guidance, he would have avoided many detours.
You don't need to think about how many martial arts and supernatural powers this old devil possesses.
"Hmph, you are an ant-like thing. When you reach the immortal realm, you may be killed by someone in the middle of the journey. If you still want me to help you, just give up. Now just let me out obediently and I will treat it as if it didn't happen. Otherwise, everything will be dead!"
Ancestor Hongyun was very disdainful. Chen Changsheng was only in the Qi refining stage and he didn't look down on him at all. With such a level of cultivation, he could kill many people with his breath back then.
"Don't worry about this. Anyway, if you want to escape, you must help me, otherwise you will be prepared to stay in there for the rest of your life!"
After Chen Changsheng said the magic formula, the flying sword fell down. He jumped on the flying sword and flew towards the cultivation market.
The Cultivation Market is not far from Wangxian Sect. It can be regarded as a market dependent on the existence of Wangxian Sect. It is the place where all cultivators trade.
Now that Chen Changsheng was able to protect himself, he went to the market to buy something.
Now that he has a lot of elixirs, he can go to the market to exchange for some spiritual stones or buy some cultivation resources.
Ancestor Hongyun didn't speak, and was obviously deep in thought.
When he was still some distance away from the Cultivation Market, Chen Changsheng put away his flying sword and walked in with great swagger.
Chen Changsheng now has flying swords, spiritual weapons, and the ninth level of Qi refining. With such cultivation, he can be considered to have some ability to protect himself.
